name: Abaranger Dino Curry
instructions: Cut potatoes , carrots , and choosen meat into small pieces
Heat a deep pan and saute the onions until brown
Add choosen meat , potatoes , carrots and garlic in the pan and saute together
Add water in the pan and bring to a boil
Turn heat down to low and cook for 40-50 minute
Add potatostarch and water mixture in the soup to thicken
Add curry roux and simmer for 10 minute serve the curry over steamed rice
